title: Five pages say asymbolia patients fail to "seek treatment". Berthier et al. (1988), the primary source the corpus cites, reports lack of withdrawal, absent or inadequate emotional responses, and inability "to learn appropriate escape or protective responses", with nothing on treatment-seeking: `concepts/pain-asymbolia` L101, `topics/pain-consciousness-and-causal-power` L116, `apex/embodied-interface` L79, `voids/valence-void` L65, `concepts/reductionism` L109
